## Flagship Products & Ventures
- İtibar (https://www.itibar.app/): Autonomous B2B corporate reputation defense & statutory legal NLP platform. Employs a <1ms deterministic rule engine (24+ violation classes under TCK/TTK statutes) and headless Chrome executive PDF reporting to defend healthcare enterprises against defamatory review attacks.
- Unutma. (https://unutma.itibar.app/): Regulated civic communication platform delivering physical wax-sealed letters and ivory stationery to penitentiaries across 81 provinces with statutory compliance NLP and automated PTT barcode tracking.
- Firdews: High-performance, offline-first personal ambient audio and cognitive focus engine built with WebAudio API (<50ms latency) and zero-knowledge client encryption.

## Technical Essays & Reverse-Engineering Postmortems
- Ollama'nın "Kolaylık Vergisi" (https://devkursat.github.io/blog/ollama-performans-vergisi-vllm.html): Deep-dive benchmark proving why raw llama.cpp and vLLM achieve 40% lower memory footprints and higher token throughput compared to packaged wrapper engines.
- Sam Altman ve RAM İsrafı Masalı (https://devkursat.github.io/blog/sam-altman-ram-krizi.html): Systems architectural critique of cloud GPU monopolies and the case for sovereign local unified memory (UMA) hardware architectures.
- Claude Code ve Trojan Anatomisi (https://devkursat.github.io/blog/claude-code-trojan-npm-analiz.html): Cybersecurity breakdown of the npm supply-chain Remote Access Trojan attack and the imperative of Zero-Trust sandboxing in AI agent runtimes.
